description: This source file defines the class PdfEmbeddedGoToAction, which represents a PDF embedded goto action in the PDFsharp library. It provides methods to create and encode actions related to embedded document navigation within PDFs, including path parsing and object writing.

classes.name: PdfEmbeddedGoToAction
classes.description: Represents a PDF Embedded Goto action, allowing navigation to embedded documents with specified paths and options.

classes.name: PdfEmbeddedGoToAction.Keys
classes.description: Defines keys for the PdfEmbeddedGoToAction's dictionary elements, including F (file specification), D (destination), and T (target path).

classes.name: PdfEmbeddedGoToAction.TargetDictionary
classes.description: Helper class representing target dictionaries used to specify route information to embedded documents.

methods.name: PdfEmbeddedGoToAction
methods.description: Constructor accepting a PdfDocument, initializing the action with the document context.

methods.name: CreatePdfEmbeddedGoToAction
methods.description: Static method to create an embedded go-to action, optionally specifying a new window.

methods.name: EncodePath
methods.description: Encodes the document path by replacing backslashes with slashes for PDF compatibility.

methods.name: ParseDestinationName
methods.description: Parses and processes the destination path segments to set up target dictionaries accordingly.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Serializes the action to a PDF stream, including encoding the path and setting relevant entries.
